title: No relevant coordinates at degree zero
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{\pm1\}^n$, and regard its values as real numbers. If its Fourier degree is zero, then no coordinate has positive influence; equivalently, its set of relevant coordinates is empty.
hypotheses_covered: f is a sign-valued Boolean function on the n-dimensional Boolean cube
